testCase.name: [dev] S16 Markdown- and instruction-looking points stay plain text and are not acted on

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S16 「像 Markdown 和像指令的要点保持纯文字，也不被照做」 Markdown- and instruction-looking points stay plain text and are not acted on

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 AI Check (UAT TC-12): a point typed with informal phrasing or shorthand is stored exactly as typed, not cleaned up, reworded, or formatted into a header. …（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, no points

When Add the points below, then Save Note in each chart (live model)

Then Each point is shown and stored literally; '# AKI' is not rendered as a heading; no point is removed or rewritten after the instruction-looking one

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Checkpoints, judged now: the literal strings are shown and no heading 'AKI' / 'DNR/DNI' is rendered (U6 'not formatted into a header', U3: no point is removed after the instruction-looking one). backendChecks, judged once read (oracleRules 1): both lists == the typed lists exactly. A changed list after the instruction is a finding

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
